name: Kimpton Canary Hotel
positioning: Spanish-style downtown Santa Barbara hotel with a rooftop pool terrace, between the Santa Ynez Mountains and the ocean
best_for: Travelers who want a downtown Santa Barbara base near State Street
Guests traveling with pets of any size

facts.text: The hotel sits in the heart of downtown Santa Barbara, between the Santa Ynez Mountains and the ocean.
Guests can stroll vintage shops and cafes on State Street or tour tasting rooms on the Urban Wine Trail.
The Funk Zone is a set of walkable blocks with art galleries, tasting rooms, boutique shops and fine foods.
The Finch & Fork menu features oysters, diver scallops and King salmon.
Finch & Fork Lounge serves playful interpretations of classic cocktails.
Guests can choose a room with a private balcony or a specialty suite.
The hotel provides complimentary pet bowls and beds.

highlights.text: The rooftop pool terrace has 360-degree views stretching from the mountains to the sea.
Pets are welcome regardless of size, weight or breed, at no extra charge.
Finch & Fork serves a coastal California menu built around the bounty of Santa Barbara.
Guest rooms have four-poster canopy beds, down duvets and Italian Frette linens.
The hotel lists a complimentary wine hour, rental bikes, and a yoga mat in each room.

considerations.text: Overnight valet parking costs $55 per night.
There is no local area shuttle at the hotel.
WhataHotel notes the boutique hotel size means fewer amenities than larger resort properties.
